blocks.text: Capacitors bohat se household appliances (ghar ki bijli wali cheezon) mein istemal hote hain, jaise bijli ke pankhe, pani khenchne wali motors, washing machines, fridge, flashguns, computer keyboards aur touchscreens. Yahan kuch ko detail (tafseel) se dekhte hain.

blocks.alt: Pankhe ki motor ki wiring. Supply terminals N aur L. N ke common point se running coil (coils ka bahar wala ring) ghoom kar L tak jati hai; starting coil (andar wala ring) common point se capacitor ke zariye L tak. Labels: Common, Capacitor, Starting Coil, Running Coil.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.17: Bijli ka pankha: capacitor ke saath starting aur running coils ki wiring (kitab ki Figure 16.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; photos (tasaveer) shamil nahi).
